how_body: Online monitoring checks users' status via the VK API at the chosen interval. Visit data is kept for 7 days to build activity charts.

activity.intro: Tracks activity in chats: typing, voice, read receipts, editing and deleting messages
activity.warn_body: Spying works only while a VK tab is open in your browser. When the tab is closed, event tracking stops.

spy_typing.title: Typing a message
spy_typing.desc: Notify when a user is typing

spy_uploads.title: Uploading media
spy_uploads.desc: Notify about photo, video and file uploads

spy_read.title: Read a message
spy_read.desc: Notify when your message is read

spy_edit.title: Editing a message
spy_edit.desc: Notify when a message is edited

spy_invisibility.title: Enabled invisible mode
spy_invisibility.desc: Notify when a friend's invisible mode changes

spy_chat_events.title: Conversation events
spy_chat_events.desc: Joining, leaving and removing chat members

online.intro: Tracks when users come online and go offline. Collects activity statistics and shows charts.
online.empty_hint: Add friends to track their activity
online.notify_desc: Show when a user is online

profile.intro: Tracks profile changes via the VK API: avatar changes, status changes and new friends.
profile.interval_hint: 5–15 minutes is recommended — the VK API rate-limits requests

avatar.title: Avatar change
avatar.desc: Notify when a user changes their avatar

friends.title: New friends
friends.desc: Notify when the friend count changes
